triggers.A: new external evidence: independent publication/replication of persistent post-publication risk-adjusted excess return
triggers.B: new structural edge: institutional constraint, risk transfer, microstructure, forced flows, regulatory effect, structural carry or liquidity provision
triggers.C: capital change: available capital changes materially from 200 USDT (CAPITAL_CHANGE_REVIEW, no arbitrary fixed amount)
triggers.D: broker/instrument change: new fractional access, low-cost instrument, UCITS product, retail derivative or materially better cost structure
triggers.E: new data: only if it unlocks an already economically supported hypothesis (data alone is never enough)

minimum_evidence_sources: strong enough to beat a passive alternative after costs
no_profitability_by_test_count: tests are engineering, not economic evidence

rfc046_limited_exemption.decision: option 5A - specific, dated RFC-041 exemption; offline research only
rfc046_limited_exemption.scope: Controlled Discovery (RFC-046): offline hypotheses, offline experiments, independent verification
rfc046_limited_exemption.stop: DISCOVERY_STOP_RULES.md; no automatic refill; revocable by the owner
